title: Summer Story. Objects
author: Art Garden
description:
Summer decor clipart of hand drawn tropical leaves, fruits and flowers and vacation items.
This set is about taste of summer , sun and sea.
For eco  menu template, menu card, restaurant decor, packaging, price tags, banner, invitation, label, tags, restaurant wall art, food poster. tropical party decor or logo design.
Also you can match to create your own design from graphic objects.
You can add decorative or colorful backdrops as you like.
THIS SET INCLUDES:
39 PNG separate files with objects (300 dpi, RGB, transparent background)
You can use them in Illustrator, Photoshop, Canva.
